title: Player with clamped health
prompt: Implement nested class `Solution.Player`: constructor `(string name)` throws `ArgumentException` for null/whitespace names; read-only `Name`; `Health` starts at 100; `TakeDamage(int)` and `Heal(int)` throw `ArgumentException` for negative amounts, otherwise health stays clamped to [0, 100]; `IsAlive` is true exactly when Health > 0.

tests.name: lifecycle
tests.hint: Health floors at 0; IsAlive uses strictly greater-than, so 0 is dead.

tests.name: bounds-and-validation
tests.hint: Both clamps matter: no negatives in, no values outside [0, 100] out.
